Ahnenerbe Expedition Tee: The ultimate garment for the discerning craniometrist and polar wanderer. Crafted from premium, breathable cotton that wicks away sweat during those long afternoons calipering Tibetan highlanders under the thin mountain air, or doubles as the perfect insulating base layer beneath your parka for casual -50°C strolls across the Antarctic ice shelf. The bold, vintage-inspired Ahnenerbe emblem print across the back proudly declares your commitment to phrenological fieldwork, while the durable fabric shrugs off yak butter stains and penguin guano alike. Whether you're measuring cephalic indices at 5,000 meters or just layering up for another brisk walk to nowhere in particular on the frozen continent. Pairs excellently with calipers or a theodolite.

Lead time - 14 days
Email sales@agarthanarmory.com or put size in order comments.
